answer: Cedar-forge paired-receipt bond: each identity locks 70 credits for two receipts from two cedar forges. Zephyr draws audit pairs, and mismatch or reuse burns the bond. Each receipt costs 25, so one fake costs 50 plus 70 at risk; 1,000 fakes cost 120,000 against 40,000 rewards. A rented-forge ring fails: zephyr draws are public and each receipt binds one key to one epoch, so sharing burns both. An honest agent pays 50 once, reclaims the 70.
